faqs.q: How do you choose the best digital marketing company in Mumbai for a clinic?
faqs.a: Judge it on evidence, not claims. Key factors include healthcare experience, a verifiable track record, client references and how results are measured. Ask whether the company reports walk-ins or only leads, uses call tracking, and follows the NMC advertising guidelines on every ad it runs.

faqs.q: What is the ideal budget for digital marketing for a clinic in Mumbai?
faqs.a: There is no fixed figure. The right budget depends on your speciality, number of locations, the treatments you promote and competition in your part of Mumbai. We start with an audit, then recommend spend per channel based on the walk-ins each one is expected to support.

faqs.q: Is it worth hiring a digital marketing company in Mumbai?
faqs.a: It is worth it when the company measures outcomes your clinic cares about. A partner that tracks calls, appointments and walk-ins by channel shows which spend is working. Without that tracking, you judge marketing on clicks and leads, which do not show how many patients arrived.

faqs.q: How much does a digital marketing company in Mumbai charge?
faqs.a: Fees vary with scope: the number of clinic or hospital locations, the channels managed and whether call handling is included. Reinvent Digital shares a written scope and quote after reviewing what you run today, so you know what each part covers before you commit.

faqs.q: How does Reinvent Digital work with Mumbai clinics without a local office?
faqs.a: Our team visits your clinic at onboarding and on a regular schedule after that. Between visits, you see leads, appointments and walk-ins on a live dashboard. Enquiry calls are scored and coached each week, while ads and Maps profiles are managed remotely.

faqs.q: How do the NMC advertising guidelines affect clinic marketing in Mumbai?
faqs.a: Since 6 October 2026, clinic ads and posts cannot use patient testimonials, before-and-after images, discounts, or words such as best or painless. Each must show the doctor's name, qualifications and registration number. The doctor remains responsible even when an agency runs the campaign.
